findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Potential command execution via os.system or subprocess in distlib
 * @description Finds direct uses of os.system and subprocess.* that may execute shell commands
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/distlib/command-execution-direct
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-078
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("system").getACall()
  or
  call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["Popen", "call", "check_call", "check_output", "run"]).getACall()
select call, "Shell command execution function is used; ensure inputs are trusted and shell=False where possible."
findings.hypothesis: Direct command execution usage that might be risky depending on inputs
